story.fullStory:
Roxette's "The Look" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. It was released in early 1989 as the fourth single from their second studio album, Look Sharp.

"The Look" is a song by Swedish pop duo Roxette.

It became an international hit, and was one of the most successful singles of 1989.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 19 weeks on the chart.

is the second studio album by Swedish pop rock duo Roxette, released on 21 October 1988 by EMI, two years after their debut Pearls of Passion (1986).
It was recorded at EMI Studios in Stockholm and at Trident II Studios in London between March and September 1988.

Roxette is a Swedish pop rock duo originally consisting of Marie Fredriksson (1958–2019) and Per Gessle and currently consisting of Gessle and Lena Philipsson.
Both Gessle and Fredriksson were already established musicians in Sweden prior to the band's formation.
The song appears on the album "Look Sharp!" (1989).
Fredriksson had released several successful solo albums, while Gessle had been the lead singer and songwriter of Gyllene Tider, a band which had three number one albums in Sweden.
